id: MOTSCALE3: registered extension of MOTSCALE part A (lateral) and MOTSCALE2 (fore-aft) to delays of 10 and 30 ms
registered: 2026-11-12, before any MOTSCALE3 run. The 0/20/40 ms results of MOTSCALE (lateral) and MOTSCALE2 (fore-aft) are known; this adds the intermediate delays so that 0-40 ms is covered in 10 ms steps. 60/80 ms were not added: hold entry of the real estimators is 10-15 ms (offline latencies up to 25 ms), so 40 ms already exceeds the relevant range.
design: identical to the source experiments except the delay: true push force delayed (evaluation configuration as BUDF, capture-prediction release only), conditions Q, L, M, LM; delays 10 and 30 ms. Lateral y+: forces 40-90 N in 5 N steps, seeds 1400-1402 (same seeds as MOTSCALE, tag msa). Fore-aft x+: forces 30-70 N in 5 N steps, seeds 1403-1405 (same seeds as MOTSCALE2, tag msc). 4 x 2 x (11 x 3 + 9 x 3) = 480 runs. The 0 ms reference boundary of each condition and direction is taken from the source experiment unchanged.
metric: holdable force F*: 50 % crossing of the held-in-place fraction, linear interpolation on the grid (budf_analyze.py rule; censored if the lowest force is below 50 % or no crossing); FC criterion (fc_rescore.score).

predictions.D1m (primary): for L, M and LM, both directions: |F*(L)/F*(0) - exp(-omega L)| <= 0.08 at L = 10 and 30 ms (12 checks, met if all pass; censored counts as failed)
predictions.reported: Q ratios at 10 and 30 ms; the full 0-40 ms profile per condition and direction together with the source 20/40 ms results

analysis: motscale3_analyze.py (written before the runs); runner claude_brace/run_motscale.sh PART=D
